title: Bot fleet
text: A Rust Minecraft bot that performs actions on servers and farms in-game money, and a Go backend with a Vue panel that manages many of them. Each bot instance runs on its own VPS, with a small Go agent beside it reporting back to the controller.
points: Rust bot built on the open-source [azalea](https://github.com/azalea-rs/azalea) library
Go controller and Vue panel (Go + TypeScript)

title: Blueprint
text: A framework to unify Paper, Velocity and other Minecraft projects with a modular design and minimal code. It is the base I now build new plugins on, and it is public on GitHub.
points: Commands, configuration and modules in one API

title: DumbleLand
text: A Minecraft server that I ran and developed with my friend Lecer. We wrote the economy, claims, essentials, Slimefun content and the Discord bot ourselves, and the server had its own website and ruby store.
points: Discord bot: rules, tickets, claim logs and duplication alerts
GTA-style roleplay gamemode with roles, levels, shops, mines and a profile HUD

title: JustMC network
text: Plugin developer for the JustMC prison network. Over about 12 months I wrote or maintained roughly 25 plugins for it.
points: Gangs, RankUP, Pets, Robots, Cells, BlackMarket and more
Minigames platform with its API, and Duels

title: Youtuber Events
text: I host server events and build the plugins behind them. IslandsWar ran for multiple seasons for the YouTuber [Doormendez](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQ03_xKtV23EBU8ZB8T6YrQ), on an event plugin, with up to 200 players online at once. I also hosted the [SirMrNaruto](https://www.youtube.com/@NarutoSenpai) event and PastoSMP.
points: IslandsWar: multiple seasons hosted for Doormendez

title: Minefront
text: Two plugins for a skyblock server built on SuperiorSkyblock2: a masteries system where players level ore, crop, mob and farming tiers for perks, and island collectors with a value cauldron and a transaction history.
points: Masteries with tiers, perks, XP sources and achievement rewards
Island collector, value cauldron and transaction history
Paper 1.20.4, hooked into SuperiorSkyblock2 and the shop and stacker plugins
